ma.onSocketClose(function callback)

Listen for WebSocket connection closing events.

Parameter

function callback

Callback function used when a WebSocket connection closing event is detected.

Parameter

Object res**
Attribute Type Description
code Number A numeric value representing the status number of the closed connection, indicating the reason why the connection is closed.
reason String A readable string, indicating the reason why the connection is closed.

Sample Code

ma.connectSocket({
  url: 'wss://example.com'
});
ma.closeSocket();
ma.onSocketClose((res) => {
  console.log(res);
});
